items.title: Marian McPartland — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: All the people who did work with him from time to time, like Eddie Locke on drums.

ctx.x: By the way, for our listeners, Marian is referring to the 1998 JVC Jazz Festival, which is on June 22nd, will be a tribute to Mr. Jimmy McPartland, hosted by Marian and a myriad of guests and associates who were either close associates of Jimmy’s, but, or influenced by his style.

All the people that worked with him, I think I’ve managed to collect. All of them. All the people who did work with him from time to time, like Eddie Locke on drums. Bill Crow worked with him a lot. Howard Alden. Warren Vaché. Jimmy admired Warren Vaché a great deal.
Did Jimmy play the cornet exclusively?
